extracted.intended_audience: independent local news publishers and aspiring news entrepreneurs in the U.S. and Canada; potential LION members and funders
extracted.subtask_description: Describes LION Publishers' mission, programs, and organizational values aimed at helping independent local news organizations build more sustainable businesses and professional networks. Intended as guidance for publishers considering membership, programs, or awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission: strengthen local news industry
rubrics_metrics.description: The mission of LION is to strengthen the local news industry by helping independent news publishers build more sustainable businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses LION's work primarily on the business side of news entrepreneurship rather than journalism skills; frames program and service priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision: equitable access to inclusive impactful news
rubrics_metrics.description: A world where thriving, independent news organizations provide equitable access to inclusive and impactful news and information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets high-level aspirational outcome for member organizations and LION's programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable business outcome: pay a living wage
rubrics_metrics.description: Businesses that can pay a living wage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An explicit benchmark for financial sustainability and staff compensation LION aims to help members achieve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable business outcome: recruit and retain talent
rubrics_metrics.description: Businesses that can recruit and retain talent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational/HR stability is framed as a concrete goal for sustainable local news organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable business outcome: grow reach, revenue, and impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Businesses that can grow their reach, revenue, and impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Growth across audience, financial, and mission-impact dimensions is treated as a key measure of success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainable business outcome: long-term viability ('here to stay')
rubrics_metrics.description: Businesses that are here to stay.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes organizational longevity as an overarching criterion for sustainability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability Audits
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustainability Audits provide publishers with a detailed analysis of their business's strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities — along with practical recommendations to guide their next steps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Self-serve assessment available to all LION members anytime; launched in 2021 with hundreds completed; intended to identify actionable next steps for business improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability 360 program
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustainability 360 is a year-long program offering hands-on support to publishers eager to expand their businesses; participants are paired with a strategic coach and consultants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on developing processes, systems, and documentation to address top finance and HR needs; cohort model (second cohort beginning early 2026).

rubrics_metrics.name: LION Sustainability Awards — eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: LION Sustainability Awards are open to all LION members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual program culminating in a Ceremony & Dinner at the LION Summit; recognizes excellence by local independent online news businesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award pillar: journalistic impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalistic impact is a pillar of sustainability used to recognize excellence in LION Sustainability Awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of the award dimensions alongside financial health and operational resilience; used to evaluate member organizations' mission-driven outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award pillar: financial health
rubrics_metrics.description: Financial health is a pillar of sustainability used to recognize excellence in LION Sustainability Awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates an organization's fiscal sustainability and business model robustness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award pillar: operational resilience
rubrics_metrics.description: Operational resilience is a pillar of sustainability used to recognize excellence in LION Sustainability Awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on systems, processes, and capacity that allow organizations to withstand challenges and continue functioning.

rubrics_metrics.name: News Entrepreneur Academy — essential small business skills
rubrics_metrics.description: The News Entrepreneur Academy offers self-guided courses that teach essential small business skills, including preparing a budget and creating a revenue growth plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coursework is designed for LION members to build core financial planning and growth capabilities; self-guided format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expert Network — matching to recommended experts
rubrics_metrics.description: The LION Expert Network is a members-only service to help news leaders connect with, consult with, and hire recommended experts who match their specific needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical resource for filling capacity gaps; emphasizes tailored matches between publishers and consultants/experts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership benefits and eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: LION members receive exclusive benefits, including opportunities for coaching and funding, discounted media liability insurance, eligibility for the LION Sustainability Awards, access to peer learning and support, and ongoing professional development training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership is positioned as the route to access LION's programs and benefits; membership also underwrites organizational support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Data-informed
rubrics_metrics.description: We can’t make an impact without defining how to measure our impact. We strive for excellence in our work by gathering data, consistently articulating what success looks like, measuring our progress, and making time to celebrate our learnings, regardless of whether we achieve our intended outcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies organizational practice: define metrics, collect data, track progress, and celebrate learnings; used as a standard for programs and internal practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Equitable and inclusive
rubrics_metrics.description: We stand against racist and discriminatory business and editorial practices that oppress historically marginalized communities. We believe the most impactful journalism effectively reflects a community’s diverse perspectives while prioritizing the stories of those who have been historically overlooked or marginalized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commits LION and members to inclusive editorial and business practices and to creating space for underrepresented leaders and voices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: People-centered
rubrics_metrics.description: Good design requires being responsive to people’s needs, which includes practicing empathy, holding ourselves and others accountable to shared standards, and always prioritizing people’s personal well-being over work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational expectation to prioritize wellbeing, empathy, and accountability in organizational choices and program design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Systems thinkers
rubrics_metrics.description: We always consider how individual pieces of our work fit into a larger vision. We solve complex challenges by thinking about the systems in which they function rather than discrete problems. We balance the need to scale our work with the recognition that not all solutions are one-size-fits-all, and we support unique needs as we are able.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages holistic, scalable approaches that account for context and avoid one-size-fits-all prescriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Transparent
rubrics_metrics.description: Open information and candid communication are at the heart of building trust. This includes acknowledging mistakes, learning out loud about what is and isn’t working, and sharing the thought process behind major decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets a standard for openness internally and with members and the public, including disclosure of relationships and decision rationales.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Iterative
rubrics_metrics.description: We believe there is always room for improvement. We commit to using the iterative 'build-measure-learn' loop to design experiments, measure outcomes, and gain new insights as we support sustainable models for local, independent news businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopts an experimental, learning-oriented approach to program and product development; implies running measured pilots and refining based on data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value: Collaborative
rubrics_metrics.description: We seek to build strong relationships with colleagues and external stakeholders to learn and grow from their expertise, ensure we aren’t duplicating efforts, and share capacity and resources toward achieving a common goal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages partnership, resource-sharing, and coordination across organizations to strengthen the broader ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency: staff, board, and vendor disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: The LION Publishers is committed to providing our members, our board of directors, and the public with transparent disclosures on the companies and businesses we’ve worked with, or currently work with, in the course of our careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintains disclosure statements for staff, board, and vendors as a public accountability mechanism; supports trust-building.
